d.ko: DISCOPUP is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.
d.en: DISCOPUP is a mystery game about a seal who wants to sneak inside a dogs-only party. Explore the city and meet shady characters as your search for the perfect dog costume.
d.zh: 《汪汪迪厅》是一款叙事游戏，讲述了一只海豹想方设法溜进只准狗参加的派对的故事。探索城市，寻找能把自己打扮成狗的完美饰品，顺便会一会各路可疑的角色。
